rules.recommendation: Adapter Pattern: Wrap the static database call in an interface-backed Adapter. Inject the Adapter into this component to enable unit testing and decouple from the legacy storage mechanism.
Dependency Injection: Avoid directly instantiating dependencies using the 'new' keyword. Extract the dependency into a constructor argument to invert control and improve testability.

Facade Pattern: This stateless God Class is acting as a dumping ground for procedural logic. Extract cohesive functions into dedicated Service classes, and convert this class into a Facade if callers still need a unified entry point.
